verdict.rationale: Channel3 ships a /v1 path-versioned API with a dated semver changelog, explicit breaking-change migration instructions, per-release compatibility statements, and in-docs deprecation notices. However, there is no standalone deprecation policy defining notice windows or sunset timelines, so the 'documented deprecation policy' half rests on practice rather than a stated policy. missing for 10: a formal deprecation/versioning policy page with notice windows and sunset guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration of deprecation handling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
